title: FreePath: Neural Mean Free Path for Image Dehazing
abstract: arXiv:2611.07398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single image dehazing requires recovering scene radiance from visual responses that are weakened and veiled by participating media. Existing methods either invert explicit scattering variables, which can be unstable under complex scenes, or learn direct restoration mappings, which often discard the physical organization of haze formation. We present \emph{FreePath}, a neural mean free path framework for image dehazing. Instead of estimating atmospheric parameters, FreePath represents dehazing as feature space path state restoration, inspired by the expected distance a visual response can propagate before interacting with haze. Within a residual encoder and decoder, the Mean Free Path Residual Block learns path and collision fields to guide haze constrained correction, while FreePath State Conservation Integration preserves restored path states during deep feature aggregation. Experiments on paired CDD-11 haze images and real RTTS scene

translated_title: FreePath：基于神经平均自由程的图像去雾方法
translated_abstract: 单幅图像去雾需要从被参与介质削弱和遮蔽的视觉响应中恢复场景辐射。现有方法要么对显式散射变量进行反演，这在复杂场景下可能不稳定；要么学习直接的恢复映射，这往往会丢失雾形成的物理组织结构。我们提出了FreePath，一个用于图像去雾的神经平均自由程框架。FreePath不再估计大气参数，而是受视觉响应在与雾发生交互之前所能传播的期望距离的启发，将去雾表示为特征空间中的路径状态恢复。在残差编码器和解码器结构中，平均自由程残差块学习路径场和碰撞场以引导受雾约束的校正，同时FreePath状态守恒集成在深度特征聚合过程中保留已恢复的路径状态。在配对的CDD-11雾化图像和真实RTTS场景上的实验……
tldr: 提出神经平均自由程框架FreePath，将图像去雾建模为特征空间中的路径状态恢复，通过平均自由程残差块和状态守恒集成实现兼顾物理机制的雾去除。
en_tdlr: FreePath introduces a neural mean free path framework that reformulates image dehazing as path state restoration in feature space, using Mean Free Path Residual Blocks and state conservation integration for physically guided haze removal.
